Class ChaosActuatorEndpoint

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.spring.boot.common.ChaosActuatorEndpoint
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
@Endpoint(id="chaos") public class ChaosActuatorEndpoint extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Spring Boot Actuator endpoint for operating the chaos agent at runtime, with the operations, outcomes and HTTP statuses of the Micronaut and Quarkus endpoints (ChaosManagement).

Exposed at /actuator/chaos when macstab.chaos.actuator.enabled=true comes from a trusted property source. The endpoint is authenticated by whatever web security the host application applies to the Actuator namespace; it must not be published unauthenticated. Only plans activated through it can be stopped through it, and they stop when the application context closes.

    • activate

      @WriteOperation public org.springframework.boot.actuate.endpoint.web.WebEndpointResponse<ChaosManagement.ActivationResponse> activate(String planJson)
      Activates a chaos plan supplied inline in the request body ({"planJson": "<plan>"}). On Spring MVC a body above ChaosActuatorBodyLimit.MAX_BODY_BYTES is refused with 413 before it is bound; on WebFlux spring.codec.max-in-memory-size bounds it (256 KiB by default, 2MB accepts every plan of the 1 MiB plan cap).
      Parameters:
      planJson - the plan, in the startup-config JSON format
      Returns:
      the outcome, with its HTTP status
